newsitem.title: UK: MAM up further amid stock shortage.
newsitem.headline: MAM up further amid stock shortage.

text.p: Shares in Mercury Asset Management Plc romped to fresh record highs in early afternoon trading on Monday as renewed investment demand caught market-makers short of stock, dealers said.
Earlier the stock rose amid renewed takeover talk and as analysts at SBC Warburg raised their price target to 15.00 stg, saying it would be wrong to be a seller of the shares, dealers said.
The stock extended its earlier gains to be up 51-1/2p at 14.07-1/2 by 1334 GMT -- some 7.6 percent above its level at the end of January. Volume was an unspectacular 295,880 shares.

"This is a stock that is just going up every day," said one market-market. "You don't even need any new news to push it higher." The latest bout of bid speculation around what has been seen as a potential target for months was sparked by Morgan Stanley's merger agreement with Dean Witter.
Weekend reports in the UK press suggested Merrill Lynch could be mulling a bid for MAM or Schroders, up 25p at 17.77-1/2 stg. No-one at Merrill was immediately available for comment.
